concerns.analysis: Throughout the document, the extraction pipeline has duplicated images. It successfully extracts images with their captions (e.g., Figure 7 and Figure 8 on page 12), but then erroneously re-inserts identical or cropped versions of these same images as standalone tags with alt='Document image' at the end of the page block. Because the source PDF only contains one instance of these images per page, this results in visual duplication of image content.
